div.div: بَاطِيَةٌ A certain vessel; (S;) a نَاجُود [or vessel into which wine is put]; (AA, S, Mgh, K;) a large vessel of glass, which is filled with wine, or beverage, and placed amid the drinkers, who ladle out from it [into their cups], (Az, Mgh, TA,) and drink: (Az, TA:) [a wine-vase, of glass or of earthenware; an amphora; an earthen jar; now applied to a vessel of this kind into which wine and oil &c. are put:] said to be an arabicized word: (TA:) [J says,] “ I think it to be arabicized: ” (S:) but accord. to Z and Meyd, it is from 1, as mentioned above. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
